name: Forest
description: Each forest tile scores by level. 3 Points for level 1 and 4 Points for level 2.

name: Tall Forest
description: Each forest tile scores by level. 1 Points for level 1 and 5 Points for level 2.

name: Sprawling Forest
description: Each forest group scores based on its size. The more tiles a forest group has the more it scores.

name: Field
description: A field that is connected to one or more other fields scores a flat 10 points.

name: Small Fields
description: Each field without any field neighbors scores 5 points.

name: Large Fields
description: A field that is connected to two or more other fields scores a flat 20 points.

name: Mountains
description: Mountains score only if they are connected to another mountain. A level 1 mountain scores 2 points, a level 2 mountain scores 5 points and a level 3 mountain scores 9 points.

name: Tall Mountains
description: Mountains score only if they are connected to another mountain. A level 1 mountain scores 4 points, a level 2 mountain scores 5 points and a level 3 mountain scores 6 points.

name: Isolated Mountains
description: Mountains score only if they are NOT connected to another mountain. A level 1 mountain scores 4 points, a level 2 mountain scores 5 points and a level 3 mountain scores 6 points.

name: Long River
description: Score by the length of the river. It only scores the shorted route from end to end. The longer the river the more points you score.

name: Short River
description: Score by the length of the river. It only scores the shorted route from end to end. You earn more and more points until your river is 5 tiles long.

name: River
description: Each river tile scores 4 points. The shape or length of the river does not matter.

name: Wetland
description: A wetland scores 12 points if it has at least 3 different neighboring elements. Different tile levels dont affect the scoring.

name: Wetland Neighbors
description: A wetland scores 4 points per different neighboring element. The more different elements the more points you score.

name: Wetland Group
description: A wetland that is connected to one or more other wetlands scores a flat 20 points.
